def snap():
    nodes=current_frame.segmentation['nodes']; out=[]
    for n in nodes:

            out.append((n['boundary'][0][1], n['boundary'][2][1], ''.join(dots)))
    return sorted(out)
print('start', snap())
for i in range(4):

    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'): break
